title: Require a first-article sign-off before any AI tool runs on your repo
today: Today you can't prove a new AI tool behaves correctly on your real code before it touches your files.
with_this: With this, you can let a new assistant change your project only after it passes a trial run on a copy of your own past tasks.

title: Accept AI code changes by lot sampling, not one-by-one review
today: Today you can't review every AI-written change in a big batch, so bad edits slip through or review takes forever.
with_this: With this, you can accept a week of assistant edits by checking a random sample, and know the escape rate of defects.

title: Zone the codebase so briefs build only where allowed
today: Today you can't stop a helper from quietly building housing in the middle of the industrial core, so every parallel change lands wherever it happens to fit.
with_this: With this, you can declare which parts of your project are residential, industrial, or mixed, and every parallel job only builds in its permitted zone, so unrelated changes stop bleeding into your co…

title: Give small quick-lane briefs their own express route
today: Today you can't get a tiny change through quickly when a big refactor is jamming the same road, so trivial fixes wait behind sprawling work.
with_this: With this, you can push tiny fixes through their own fast lane while large work continues, so the small bugs your users report get fixed the same day.

title: Set fixed merge windows so parallel streams converge on time
today: Today you can't predict when parallel work will rejoin the main thread, so everyone's changes land at unpredictable moments and collide.
with_this: With this, you can set merge times the way a train runs a timetable, so your team knows exactly when results arrive and you can plan reviews and releases without guessing.

title: Make owners of neglected pages pay for their upkeep
today: Today you can't make anyone pay for the pages that go stale, so the busiest pages rot as often as the quiet ones.
with_this: With this, you can keep the most-read sections accurate, because the owners of heavily trafficked but out-of-date pages carry a visible cost until those pages are fixed.

title: Require a building permit before changing documented behavior
today: Today you can't know a code change altered documented behavior until a reader complains about it.
with_this: With this, you can stop silent breakage before it ships, since a change that alters what the docs promise waits for the page owner's sign-off.

title: Certify each new agent with evidence before it touches code
today: Today you can't know, before an agent runs on your code, whether it will behave correctly on the cases that matter to you.
with_this: With this, you can approve a new agent for your organization on evidence instead of a vendor's promise.

title: Buy insurance on each release before it ships
today: Today you can't buy protection against a release going bad, so a bad Friday push lands on you alone.
with_this: With this, you can pay a small premium up front and have the rollback cost covered automatically if the release fails in its first days.

title: Quarantine file writes from unverified background agents
today: Today you can't prevent a background task that loses its identity from writing corrupt code to your active file.
with_this: With this, you can ensure that any task which loses its link to the main session is automatically locked out of writing to the file, forcing it to request manual approval for every change.

title: Let Sampo trade execution rights via internal auction
today: Today you can't dynamically reallocate computational focus based on task criticality during execution
with_this: With this, Sampo can improve its orchestration by allowing sub-tasks to bid for CPU cycles, ensuring high-value steps get priority while low-impact steps yield resources automatically.

title: Create a spot market for unused developer time
today: Today you can't automatically assign tasks to developers based on their current availability and skill set
with_this: With this, Sampo can improve its orchestration by creating a 'spot market' where developers can sell their available time, and Sampo can buy it to assign tasks optimally, maximizing overall productiv…

title: Allocate compute resources via market-based auction
today: Today you can't prioritize parallel tasks based on their immediate value to the project
with_this: With this, Sampo can dynamically allocate its internal processing power to the most critical tasks, starving low-priority noise

title: Derive reliability derivatives from production telemetry
today: Today you can't create financial instruments based on the performance of your code
with_this: With this, you can issue internal bonds that pay out based on the actual uptime and latency of your services

title: Bid against production latency to reserve compute capacity
today: Today you can't dynamically reserve CPU and memory in a way that automatically cancels if the cost exceeds the revenue saved by the speedup
with_this: With this, you can let the system automatically scale down non-critical background jobs when real-time user latency spikes, ensuring peak performance without manual throttle adjustments

title: Short the merge queue for conflicting PRs using a priority auction
today: Today you can't prevent merge conflicts that arise from simultaneous PRs targeting the same files.
with_this: With this, you can let PRs bid for file access, so only the highest-priority or lowest-risk change merges first.
